A moisture-rich gel mask formulated with Sodium DNA (PDRN), niacinamide and hydrolyzed collagen to help hydrate and enhance the appearance of smooth, radiant skin. Its gel format provides a refreshing treatment while leaving the complexion feeling soft and replenished.

Key Benefits

  • Provides intensive hydration.
  • Helps support skin elasticity.
  • Helps improve the appearance of dullness.
  • Supports smoother, plumper-looking skin.
  • Contains niacinamide.
  • Features hydrolyzed collagen.

How to Use

After cleansing and toning, apply the gel mask evenly to the face. Leave on for the recommended time stated on the packaging, then remove and gently pat any remaining essence into the skin.

Suitable For

Normal, dry, combination and dehydrated skin, especially those concerned with dullness, loss of moisture or skin that lacks a plump appearance.
